data.desc: American Resources Corporation is developing an integrated critical materials ecosystem through its Platform Orchestration strategy, bringing together commercial feedstock origination, industrial processing, and advanced refining through its strategic affiliation with, and former parent relationship to, ReElement Technologies Corporation. The Company's modular, asset-light business model emphasizes disciplined capital allocation, scalable growth, and strategic partnerships, supporting resilient, commercially sustainable supply chains across infrastructure, defense, advanced manufacturing, semiconductors, energy, and electrification markets.
